name: Physical ensemble campaign: fail-closed gate specification
status: DRAFT - NOT frozen, NOT hashed, NOT an approved run protocol. Machine-readable transcription of docs/PHYSICAL_CAMPAIGN_PLAN.md (commit c4d1dc1) sections 3-8, used only by the fail-closed driver and its tests. It will be superseded by the frozen protocol after the pilot addendum.

seeds.N_note: fixed by the pilot addendum (plan section 3.1); the driver refuses to build the gate registry without it

statistics.rank_tie_rule: ascending p_hi_final; ties broken by protocol test order (observables in listed order, then contrast list order); affects only the reported rank/threshold, not the Holm rejection set
statistics.schema_note: columns follow docs/PHYSICAL_CAMPAIGN_PLAN.md section 5.3 (h) / R3-5; K_stage1 is the Stage-1 exceedance count of every test, needed to verify the Stage-2 selection rule (f)

reproducibility_selection.decision: selection procedure specified in R7; seed NOT YET SUPPLIED: the C0 gate stays NOT EVALUABLE until it is recorded
reproducibility_selection.seed_representation: one non-negative integer in ASCII decimal digits 0-9 only, dedicated to C0 (must differ from bootstrap_rng.root_entropy); recorded as text in selection_seed
reproducibility_selection.seed_sequence: numpy.random.SeedSequence(entropy=seed) (no spawn key; separate from the bootstrap SeedSequence)
reproducibility_selection.units_order: all (W, zeta, seed) units of the confirmatory ensemble (16 cells x N seeds), sorted ascending by W, then zeta, then seed (numeric); the keys are unique, so there are no ties
reproducibility_selection.subset_size: n = ceil(reproducibility_subset_fraction * 16 * N) in exact rational arithmetic, i.e. (16 N + 99) // 100 for the fraction 0.01
reproducibility_selection.api: perm = numpy.random.Generator(numpy.random.PCG64(numpy.random.SeedSequence(entropy=seed))).permutation(M), M = 16 N; selected = sorted(perm[:n]); subset = [units[i] for i in selected]
reproducibility_selection.row_columns: each subset row records selection_algorithm, selection_seed and selection_numpy_version

bootstrap_rng.decision: APPROVED in R7 (option A of docs/CAMPAIGN_STATUS_CONTRACT.md section 1). root_entropy NOT YET SUPPLIED: the RNG gate stays NOT EVALUABLE until it is recorded, before any physical campaign data are generated.
bootstrap_rng.root_entropy_representation: one non-negative integer written in ASCII decimal digits 0-9 only (no sign, exponent, decimal point or non-ASCII digits; surrounding whitespace is ignored); recorded as text in bootstrap_seed_stage1 / bootstrap_seed_stage2
bootstrap_rng.spawn_procedure: children = root.spawn(2); stage1 = children[0] (spawn_key == (0,)); stage2 = children[1] (spawn_key == (1,)). Equivalent construction used for validation: numpy.random.SeedSequence(entropy=root_entropy, spawn_key=(i,)). The root's own stream is not used.
bootstrap_rng.resampling_order: replicates b = 0, 1, ..., B-1 of a stage are drawn in this order, one call per replicate, N = number of confirmatory seeds; replicate b gives the resampled seed list applied to every cell, energy and observable, i.e. to all 68 tests (paired). A batched implementation is admissible only if it reproduces exactly this index sequence.
bootstrap_rng.stream_id_description: Machine-readable template in stream_id_template (placeholders in braces). Example for Stage 1: SEEDSEQ-PCG64-SPAWN-A|entropy=<E>|spawn_key=(0,)|bitgen=PCG64|numpy=2.5.3. Validators render stream_id_template; this prose is never parsed.
bootstrap_rng.probe: bootstrap_probe_stage<s> = sha256 hex digest of the first replicate's indices of stage s: Generator(PCG64(SeedSequence(entropy=root_entropy, spawn_key=(s-1,)))).integers(low=0, high=N, size=N, dtype=int64, endpoint=False) as little-endian int64 bytes
bootstrap_rng.independent_validation: aggregator and independent verifier each (separately coded) check: rule name, PCG64, numpy version and API strings equal the protocol; seeds equal root_entropy; stream identifiers equal the declared format with spawn keys (0,) and (1,); one Stage-1 stream for all 68 tests and one Stage-2 stream for all Stage-2 tests; the probes are recomputed with the pinned numpy (NOT EVALUABLE if the installed numpy differs from the pin)
bootstrap_rng.independence_statement: Stage-1 and Stage-2 streams are independent by design under the declared RNG mechanism (distinct SeedSequence spawn keys of one root); this is not a mathematical proof of statistical independence

bootstrap_rng_specified_by_plan: section 5.3 (a): one replicate resamples the confirmatory seeds jointly for all cells, energies and both observables -> all 68 tests share the Stage-1 replicates (one Stage-1 stream)

section 5.3 (f) step 3: Stage 2 draws B2 = 1e6 new replicates from an independent random stream, 'a separate, recorded child of the bootstrap SeedSequence, never overlapping Stage 1' -> one Stage-2 stream shared by all Stage-2 tests
section 5.2 / 5.3 (h): the bootstrap RNG seeds are fixed and recorded

bootstrap_rng_alternatives_for_review.label: A
bootstrap_rng_alternatives_for_review.rule: SeedSequence(entropy=E_boot) root; Stage 1 = child spawn_key (0,), Stage 2 = child spawn_key (1,); PCG64
bootstrap_rng_alternatives_for_review.note: both streams are siblings derived by SeedSequence hashing from one recorded entropy

bootstrap_rng_alternatives_for_review.label: B
bootstrap_rng_alternatives_for_review.rule: SeedSequence(entropy=E_boot) root used directly for Stage 1; Stage 2 = root.spawn(1)[0] (spawn_key (0,)); PCG64
bootstrap_rng_alternatives_for_review.note: literal reading of 'a child of the bootstrap SeedSequence'

bootstrap_rng_alternatives_for_review.label: C
bootstrap_rng_alternatives_for_review.rule: PCG64(SeedSequence(E_boot)) for Stage 1; Stage 2 = the same bit generator advanced with .jumped(1)
bootstrap_rng_alternatives_for_review.note: non-overlap of the two subsequences follows from the jump distance (2^127 steps); still not a proof of statistical independence

bootstrap_rng_alternatives_for_review.label: D
bootstrap_rng_alternatives_for_review.rule: Philox counter-based generator, one key, Stage 1 / Stage 2 distinguished by a distinct counter block or key word
bootstrap_rng_alternatives_for_review.note: counter-based; streams disjoint by construction of the counter space

bootstrap_rng_alternatives_for_review.label: E_boot source (applies to A-D)
bootstrap_rng_alternatives_for_review.rule: E_boot fixed in the frozen protocol before any confirmatory data exist, either as a recorded integer or derived deterministically from the frozen protocol hash
bootstrap_rng_alternatives_for_review.note: prevents choosing a seed after seeing results

verification_tolerance.definition: reported value a and recomputed value b agree iff both are finite and |a - b| <= atol + rtol * max(|a|, |b|)
structural_exactness: K = B => mc_ci_sim99_hi == 1.0 and p_hi_final == 1.0 exactly
verification_tolerance.scope: applies only to the consistency of reported floats with values recomputed from the integer counts; Holm sets, Stage-2 selection, ranks and decision labels are recomputed from the integer counts and never depend on it
verification_tolerance.justification: docs/CAMPAIGN_STATUS_CONTRACT.md section 2 (measured: CP endpoints vs exact binomial tails <= 7.6e-14 relative; worst formula cancellation mc_se 2.5e-11 relative at K = B-1, B = 1e6; smallest nonzero compared quantity 3.7e-11)

C2_adjudication_note: PROTOCOL DECISION REQUIRED: the plan says a flagged C2 realization is 'adjudicated with M4 (exact lattice) as in B3Y' but defines no numerical resolution criterion for a single resolution (the B3Y growth rule needs several dx). A reviewer must specify: (1) which comparison resolves a discrepancy (e.g. eps_M1 and/or eps_M3 against M4, at which limit); (2) which M4 gates (X4/X5/X7 and e_ind limit) the adjudicating solve must pass and which columns record them; (3) the outcome vocabulary (e.g. RESOLVED / PRECISION-LIMITED / UNEXPLAINED); (4) how an outcome is reported in the campaign status (the plan already fixes: never PASS, at best 'COMPLETED WITH ADJUDICATED EXCEEDANCES'). Until then ADJUDICATED means only that a record exists (administrative), and the resolution gate is NOT EVALUABLE whenever a C2 row is flagged.
bootstrap_rng_open_decisions: root_entropy (one non-negative integer, recorded before any physical campaign data are generated)
reproducibility_selection_open_decisions: seed (dedicated C0 selection seed, recorded before the confirmatory run)
C2_adjudication_open_decisions: the exact M4 comparison (which of eps_M1 / eps_M3 against the exact-lattice S, and at which matrix norm)
the M4 validation gates the adjudicating solve must pass (X4 / X5 / X7, e_ind limit)
the recorded columns for those gates and comparisons
the outcome vocabulary (e.g. RESOLVED / PRECISION-LIMITED / UNEXPLAINED)
how adjudicated exceedances are reported (the plan already fixes: never PASS; at best COMPLETED WITH ADJUDICATED EXCEEDANCES)
